units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:6">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>והיה זריז במִשְׁלַחְתּוֹ</he> and he (Naftali) was zealous in carrying out his mission.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 8:8:1">Koh. R. to VIII, 8</cite>. (expl. <cite ref="M02915"><he>משלחת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 8:8:1">ib.</cite>) <he>אין אדם וכ׳</he> (‘there is no substitution in war’,) none can say to the angel of death, let my slave or an inmate of my house go in my place.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:9">B. Mets. VII, 9</cite>; a. e., v. <cite ref="G00001"><he>זְאֵב</he></cite>.
